div.head: VIII Atr 1.1
div.ab: And gif æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes ciricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnon ciricwagum mansleaga wurðe, þonne sy þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þara þe Godes freond sy, buton þæt gewurðe, þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece, þæt se cyningc him þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið God ge wið men.

⁊ gyf æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes cyricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnan cyricwagum manslaga weorðe, þonne sy þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þæra þe Godes freond sy, butan þæt geweorðe, þæt he þanan ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsócne gesece, þæt se cyning him þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið Godd ge wið men.

And gif æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes ciricgrið swa abrece þæt he binnon ciricwagum mansleaga wurðe, þonne sy þæt botleas, ⁊ ehte his ælc þara þe Godes freond sy, buton þæt gewurðe þæt he þanon ætberste ⁊ swa deope friðsocne gesece þæt se cyningc him þurh þæt feores geunne, wið fulre bote ge wið God ge wið men.

And gif æfre ænig man heonan forð Godes ciricgrið swa abrece, þæt he binnon ciricwagum mansleaga wurðe, þonne sy þæt botleas and ehte his ælc þara þe Godes freond sy, buton þæt gewurðe þæt he þanon ætberste and swa deope friðsocne gesece þæt se cyningc him þurh þæt feores geunne wið fulre bote ge wið God ge wið men.

Und wenn je hinfort jemand den Sonderfrieden einer Kirche Gottes so weit verletzt, dass er innerhalb der Kirchenmauern Todtschläger wird, dann sei dies unabbüssbar, und verfolge ihn jeder derer, der Gottes Freund ist; ausser wenn es geschieht, dass er von dannen entkomme und ein so gewichtiges Friedensasyl erreiche, dass um dessen willen der König ihm das Leben schenkt, bei voller Busse sowohl gegenüber der Kirche als den Weltlichen:

And if ever henceforth anyone so violates the protection of a church of God that he becomes a manslayer within the church walls, then let that be beyond compensation, and let everyone who is God's friend pursue him; unless it happens that he escapes from there and reaches so weighty a sanctuary that for its sake the king grants him his life, on full compensation both to God and to men:

And if ever anyone henceforth violates the protection of the church of God by committing homicide within its walls, the crime shall not be atoned for by any payment of compensation, and everyone who is the friend of God shall pursue the miscreant, unless it happen that he escapes from there and reaches so inviolable a sanctuary that the king, because of that, grant him his life, upon condition that he makes full amends both towards God and men.

And if ever henceforth any man so violates the sanctuary of God’s Church that he commits homicide within the church walls, that then is beyond compensation, and each of those who are friends of God is to be at enmity with him, unless it happen that he escapes from there and reaches so important a sanctuary that the king grants him his life on that account, in return for full compensation both to God and to men.

And henceforth, if anyone ever violates the sanctuary of God’s church by committing murder within its walls, then no compensation can be made and all of God’s friends must track him down, unless it so happens that he escapes and obtains such powerful protection that the king therefore grants him his life in exchange for full penance to God and the community.

note.seg: Ebd. 6ff.—Hieraus I Cn 2, 3 = Hn 11, 1. 79, 5. Nur Norðengla lage sieht in Todesstrafe für Totschlag in der Kirche Grið 13. Ob VI Atr durch VIII Atr benutzt ist, bleibt fraglich; man bessere die Marginalie in: Vgl. EGu 1

Ibid. 6ff.—From this, I Cn 2, 3 = Hn 11, 1. 79, 5. Only Norðengla lage provides for the death penalty for homicide in a church; Grið 13. Whether VI Atr is used by VIII Atr remains doubtful; the marginal note should be corrected to: Vgl. EGu 1
